study.question: Can the strongest joint model retain click discrimination after removing sequence direction while retaining the original unordered endpoint pair and open-path order, and does this outperform also discarding the cut by dihedral canonicalization?
study.hypothesis: Observed supplied AUC0.6685268680 exceeds lexical0.6659442302, ring0.6653833650 and dihedral0.6655284228; global reversal0.6683840769 stays much closer. The untested hypothesis is that the boundary-anchored open path contains useful predictive structure even when which endpoint is most recent is removed. Canonicalize each valid complete-event sequence to the lexicographically smaller of its forward and reverse forms. This is exactly reversal invariant, retains both endpoints as an unordered pair and preserves undirected path adjacency. Compare against dihedral canonicalization, which additionally removes the cut, lexical multiset canonicalization, and supplied order. Predictive recovery would support utility of this retained representation within the fixed model, not prove a unique boundary mechanism or causal temporal effect.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines56-100 describes target-conditioned local activation and weighted-sum pooling. The local network inherits that scorer lineage but adds ten-block compression, five moments and task/context interaction from the imported incumbent. This experiment changes only complete-event layout; it is neither an exact DIN reproduction nor a claimed new attention architecture.

Pinned benchmark forward lines113-145 pools history before field/task token interactions. Retain the local incumbent rather than adopt that backbone; test reversal/cut information before all existing compression and moments. Original author implementation/paper equivalence unverified.

Pinned benchmark forward lines175-200 flattens history before tokenization/mixing. No flattening or new learned tokenizer is adopted. Our difference is a parameter-free nested-symmetry layout control on the imported joint network. No originality claim.

Closest local implementation: reuse exact complete-tuple ranks, cyclic prefix doubling and field/mask gathers. Add reversal-only open-path canonicalization and keep matched dihedral, lexical and supplied bridges. It tests loss of direction separately from loss of the original cut, which the prior ring/dihedral suite did not separate.

study.proposed_difference: Add a deterministic reversal-only path representative selected at the first unequal complete-tuple rank between packed forward and packed reverse sequences; exact ties represent identical tuple sequences. Expand the shared layout selection to path/dihedral/lexical/supplied. All four cells execute the same canonicalization helpers and gather operations before choosing output; no new parameters, random draws, timestamps, external IDs, labels or history are introduced. Preserve padding positions and transport event eligibility instead of recomputing it. This is a diagnostic follow-up; unmeasured new variants are not an improvement claim.
predictions: canonical_path will recover at least half of the previous supplied-minus-dihedral click AUC gap when compared to the new matched bridges; descriptive recovery fraction=(path-dihedral)/(supplied-dihedral), interpret only if supplied-dihedral>0.001. This is an exploratory effect-size rule, not a significance threshold.
If endpoints/open-path structure explain most observed utility, path AUC will be within0.0005 of supplied and exceed dihedral and lexical. Failure of either component weakens that explanation.

Path outputs will be exactly invariant to reversing the packed valid sequence at fixed validity positions; dihedral to any valid cyclic rotation/reversal; lexical to any valid permutation. Path is deliberately not generally invariant to rotations or arbitrary permutations.
All cells should have32192421 parameters (31793216 embedding,399205 dense). Added path comparison/sort/gather overhead must be measured; a quality tie with higher cost favors unchanged incumbent.
falsifiers: After native parity and invariance checks pass, path at or below dihedral/lexical fails the predicted benefit of retaining the cut in this representation. This does not refute every boundary mechanism.
Path within0.0005 of supplied but dihedral similarly near supplied would weaken attribution to the boundary; path below supplied by>0.0005 weakens direction dispensability under this training recipe.

Any field/action/task-mask misalignment, padding/target change, nonzero-weight invariance failure, source-gradient change, or bridge parity failure invalidates the mechanistic AUC comparison. Fix within budget before interpretation.
No reproducible direction across later paired seeds, or no measured quality/cost advantage over unchanged incumbent, prevents a repeated-support or efficiency claim.
alternative_explanations: Content-dependent orientation/cut changes compression groups, positional summaries, normalization populations and optimization
One paired seed and adaptively reused validation population do not establish statistical significance
Supplied order may encode publisher/offline artifacts; no raw timestamps or elapsed time are available

Uniform reversal trains one consistent coordinate system; per-example lexical reversal is a discontinuous content-dependent coordinate choice and can worsen finite-pass optimization even if direction is information-theoretically dispensable.

Dihedral additionally moves compression boundaries and creates circular adjacency across the original endpoints. Path-versus-dihedral therefore estimates utility of a retained open-path representation, not an isolated endpoint feature or physical time effect.
Exact tuple ranks depend on categorical encoding; arbitrary ID order is only a deterministic representative rule. Ties include action and each eligibility bit.
The incumbent improves primary click AUC but its auxiliary mean AUC is lower than the DIN baseline; no overall four-task superiority is claimed.

host_readiness.invariance: At common nonzero residual and context-output weights, check eval and identically initialized train outputs, gradients and Dice running buffers: path under valid-sequence reversal; dihedral under all rotations/reversals; lexical under arbitrary valid-event permutations. evidence_review.interpretation: All indexed fitted trials succeeded; many mechanisms had negative quality results. Prior rounds54-58 are available by authorized receipt even where only bounded index is carried here. Detail removal, block/within canonicalization, basis scrambling, transported basis near-recovery, hash layouts and cyclic/dihedral losses are retained as different trajectories, not independent training seed repetitions. Identical deterministic supplied bridges do not count as repeated evidence. DIN click AUC0.655544 versus incumbent0.668527 accompanies auxiliary mean0.861383 versus0.816849; this primary/auxiliary tradeoff remains explicit. Latest declared knowledge use in round61 did not adopt HiFormer/UniMixer/OneTrans architecture. Successful execution alone does not validate their mechanisms. Canonical ring/dihedral did not improve AUC; retain this negative result while probing endpoints rather than assuming canonicalization is inherently beneficial.
